note: This project uses desktop-first approach with max-width breakpoints being most common. `<=tablet` at 800px is the primary mobile breakpoint.
responsiveConventions: Desktop sizes set at component level, tablet/phone override inside @include media blocks.
Font sizes often use clamp() for fluid scaling between breakpoints.
Navigation collapses from text labels to icon-only at tablet.
Grid columns reduce: 5 → 3 → 2 from desktop to phone.
Safe area insets used for mobile: env(safe-area-inset-*).
